title: Google signs 396 MW geothermal PPA with Fervo's Cape Station

sources.quote: Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO), a global pioneer of next-generation geothermal energy, today announced a 396-megawatt (MW) power purchase agreement (PPA) with Google to enable the continued development of the Cape Station enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) GeoCluster, expected to come online in 2028.

explain: Google will buy 396 MW of round-the-clock geothermal power from Fervo's Cape Station in Utah (online from 2028) for a potential Utah data center, with an option to expand to nearly 1 GW. Price not disclosed. Plant: Cape Station, Beaver County, Utah.
